headline: One picture, 145 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 145 different works in 3 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 145 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 0 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.000 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 3bd0f9f33649 on 141 works, c708d05e7fea on 4 works.
The works are recorded as: Other (141), Bore-Well Recharge (2), Contour Trench (2).
These works are spread over 2 blocks: Balod, Dondi.
